Orchids

Source: vignettes/orchids.qmd

1 Introduction

This vignette guides you through downloading, processing, and analyzing Orchidaceae (Orchids) occurrence data in Australia. Data is sourced from the Atlas of Living Australia (ALA), enriched with weather station metadata, and visualized in multiple ways.

2 Load Required Packages and Utilities

Load all the helper functions using:

source("vignette-utils.R")

You can edit this script at:
ecotourism/vignettes/vignette-utils.R

3 Define Global Parameters 

organism_name <- "orchids"
organism_title <- "Orchids"
taxa <- "Orchidaceae"
start <- 2014
end <- 2024
email <- "your_email@email.com"

4 Step 1: Download and Prepare Data 

organism <- obs_data(taxa, start, end, your_email=email) |> polished_data()

5 Step 2: Save Cleaned Dataset 

mysave(organism_name, organism)

6 Step 3: Attach Nearest Weather Station 

attach_nearest_station(organism_name)

7 Step 4: Load and Preview Final Dataset 

load("../data/orchids.rda")
glimpse(orchids)

8 Data Analysis

8.1 Preview Dataset 

organism <- myload(organism_name)
organism |> glimpse()

8.2 Occurrence by State 

organism |> my_count(scientificName, obs_state, f=1) |> as_tibble()

9 Visualization

We’ll focus on selected species for visualization:

mss <- c("Acianthus", "Acianthus fornicatus")

9.1 Spatial Distribution Map 

organism |> filter(scientificName %in% mss) |> plot_map1()

9.2 Weekly Trends 

organism |> filter(scientificName %in% mss) |> plot_bar_week()

9.3 Monthly Trends 

organism |> filter(scientificName %in% mss) |> plot_bar_month()

9.4 Yearly Trends 

organism |> filter(scientificName %in% mss) |> plot_bar_year()

10 Weather Station Mapping 

organism <- myload(organism_name)
organism |> glimpse()

10.1 State-wise Weather Matching Summary 

summarize_state_frequencies(organism_name)

11 Pattern Analysis 

plot_monthly_occurrences_by_state(organism_name, mss)
plot_weekly_occurrences_by_state(organism_name, mss)
plot_seasonal_occurrence_polar(organism_name, mss)
plot_monthly_occurrence_map(organism_name, mss)
plot_monthly_occurrence_map_by_state(organism_name, mss)
plot_monthly_distribution_map(organism_name, mss)

12 Conclusion

You’ve now learned how to:

  • Access and clean orchid occurrence data from ALA
  • Add weather station proximity information
  • Analyze trends for specific genera or species

This reproducible workflow can support deeper studies into Orchid ecology and conservation through ecotourism data.
